reviews.text: The triple threat drill is stealing my SOUL. It won’t let me use my pivot foot and it just resets the drill, also, 99 drill score is basically impossible. I literally grinded to 500 ranked IN THE WORLD at this drill and I still don’t have 99 drill score. PLEASE FIX

reviews.title: Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: Not a guy that leaves bad reviews but I’m not even kidding, don’t waste your time by downloading this app. I tried 2 set ups, my backyard home court and then at a local gym. I followed every instruction but this stupid app only tracks layups, that’s it. I spent 30 minutes working out assuming it was working and then I took a little break and checked my stats just to notice I had only gotten 18 shots up and I was shooting 94.4%. Maybe the worst app I’ve ever downloaded, DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME
